info.title: StackContract.Cli
info.description:
Local-first .NET global tool that checks a stack/config contract before runtime.

stackcontract reads your Docker Compose file and a stackcontract.yml contract, then reports missing services and environment keys. It does not start containers and does not need a Docker daemon for `validate`. Local .env files are inspected for key presence only — values never appear in text or JSON output.

Commands: `stackcontract init` writes a contract from compose (and optional Options assemblies); `stackcontract validate [--strict]` checks the live tree; `stackcontract version` prints the tool version. Exit codes: 0 ok/warnings, 1 any error, 2 usage/parse. Finding codes include SVC_MISSING, ENV_REQUIRED_MISSING, ENV_OPTIONAL_MISSING, ENV_EXAMPLE_UNKNOWN, COMPOSE_PARSE, CONTRACT_INVALID, PROFILE_UNKNOWN.

Legacy ComposeContract names still work: composecontract.yml is accepted when stackcontract.yml is absent. MIT licensed. Not affiliated with Docker, Inc.

Install: `dotnet tool install -g stackcontract`. Pair with StackContract.AspNetCore to fail host start when required configuration keys are missing.
